subject: Payment hold: EU VAT self-cert + AP cutover schedule
messages:
From: Eleanor Boyd <ap@falmouth-consulting.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Payment hold — missing VAT self-cert for PO 2026-11-01

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Quick heads up — our AP team put the payment for PO 2026-11-01 on hold this morning. We attempted to process the invoice (INV-4589) but the tax team flagged that we do not have an EU VAT self-cert on file for Redwood in our vendor registry. Our treasury team requires either a VAT number (EU) or a signed self-certification form before they can release payment to non-EU vendors.

Could you confirm whether Redwood can provide a VAT registration or a signed EU VAT self-cert? If a self-cert is the right route, we need a completed PDF by end of next week to avoid 30-day delays.

Attachments: INV-4589.pdf (invoice stub)

Thanks,
Eleanor
AP Manager
Falmouth Consulting
[Attachment: INV-4589.pdf (pdf)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Boyd <ap@falmouth-consulting.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold — missing VAT self-cert for PO 2026-11-01

Hi Eleanor — thanks for flagging.

Short answer: we can provide a signed EU VAT self-cert and a vendor attestation. Redwood operates with a UK VAT registration (GB123456789) for EU invoicing; however, some customers prefer a signed self-cert as an additional control. I'll attach our standard self-cert form and the most recent PO/contract excerpt that confirms remit details.

Proposed next steps so we can unblock payment quickly:
- We (Redwood) send signed VAT_self_certification.pdf by EOD Monday (2026-11-23).
- AP completes vendor record update in your portal. If you need us to register in your vendor portal, we can request a portal SSO invite — please advise the contact and the fields required (VAT number, remit name, legal address, W-8/W-9 if applicable).
- If you require a formal PO acceptance (signature), we can sign the attached PO-acknowledgment and return via DocuSign.

Can you confirm which route your treasury prefers? If it's the self-cert path, confirm the person who will update the vendor record so Marissa and I can streamline the docs.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_VAT_self_cert_template.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Boyd <ap@falmouth-consulting.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold — missing VAT self-cert for PO 2026-11-01

Eleanor / Mina — looping in a short onboarding checklist to make the vendor update straightforward.

Key items Falmouth's AP team typically needs to complete the vendor record and release payment:
- Vendor legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Billing remit (bank): Redwood Inference Ltd (EU remit) / IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819 (example, we'll supply the exact IBAN in the packet)
- VAT: GB123456789 (or signed self-cert if you prefer)
- W-8BEN-E or equivalent for tax withholding (if your jurisdiction requires)
- PO acceptance: copy of signed PO or DocuSign confirmation (we can sign electronically)
- Invoice format: prefer UBL/PEPPOL PDF attached as well as CSV line items to match your AP import fields

I'm attaching our AP onboarding packet for your portal team to review. It contains the exact field mappings and a checklist for SSO vendor invites (if you use SSO-based vendor portals). If the vendor portal requires a certificate or contact verification, note the SSO invite flow below.

SSO / portal cutover notes (if you plan to onboard Redwood into your vendor portal):
- Request SSO invite to vendor-admin@redwood.com (we'll route to Jordan for setup).
- Typical fields that block onboarding: missing VAT number, mismatched remit name, and no proof of banking details.
- To avoid rekey errors, please attach a sample import CSV and we'll prefill our side.

Attachments: Redwood_AP_onboarding_packet.pdf (contains field mappings, sample CSV), PO-ack-template.docx

—Marissa
Senior Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_AP_onboarding_packet.pdf (pdf); Attachment: PO-ack-template.docx (docx)]

From: Eleanor Boyd <ap@falmouth-consulting.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 07:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold — missing VAT self-cert for PO 2026-11-01

Thanks for the clarity. Confirming:
- Falmouth AP will accept a signed EU VAT self-cert and the vendor attestation. Please return the signed PDFs.
- Our portal team needs the exact legal name and VAT number to complete the vendor profile. If you provide the SSO invite to vendor-admin@redwood.com, we will issue the invite and confirm the vendor token by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-25).

We do require a signed PO acceptance in DocuSign for any first-time vendor bank changes; since the remit name you indicated differs from the invoice remit on file, treasury will require the PO acknowledgment before releasing the payment.

We can schedule the portal cutover for Thu 2026-11-26 (10:00–11:00 GMT) — that works on our side if you can confirm attendees.

Regards,
Eleanor
AP Team — Falmouth Consulting
[Attachment: AP_hold_reference_4589.txt (text)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Eleanor Boyd <ap@falmouth-consulting.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Payment hold — missing VAT self-cert for PO 2026-11-01

Eleanor — great, thanks. Summary and commitments from Redwood: 

1) Deliverables (we will provide by COB Wednesday 2026-11-25):
   • Signed VAT_self_certification.pdf (scanned & signed)
   • Vendor_attestation_redwood.pdf (banking/remit confirmation)
   • Signed PO_acknowledgment via DocuSign for PO 2026-11-01 (DocuSign link will be sent by 11/25).

2) Portal cutover — Thu 2026-11-26 10:00 GMT: Jordan will join as vendor-admin to accept the SSO invite and validate the import fields. Marissa will be on the call for field mapping. Please send the SSO invite to vendor-admin@redwood.com and the sample import CSV in advance.

3) Payment timing: once the signed certs and the PO acknowledgment are on file and the vendor record is updated, please confirm expected payment window so we can share with our accounting team. Our expectation is release within 5 business days of record completion, but we leave timing to your treasury process.

If that's all aligned, we'll proceed and return the documents Wednesday morning in UTC.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: VAT_self_certification.pdf (pdf); Attachment: Vendor_attestation_redwood.pdf (pdf); Related DocuSign link: https://app.redwood.com/po/confirm/XYZ-2026-11-01]
